//: Settings for the static-site checks in scripts/check/ (installed by /agent-fe-nextjs-static:setup; this file is yours to edit). Every key is optional: the value shown is the default, and a key you leave out keeps it. Keys starting with // are notes.
//mode: auto reads next.config: output: 'export' means export (pure static hosting), anything else ssg-with-endpoints (prerendered pages plus a few route handlers). Pin it when next.config computes the output.
//siteUrl: The production origin, such as https://www.example.com: canonical URLs, the sitemap, hreflang and share images are checked against it. Empty means the variable named by siteUrlEnv supplies it.
//outDir: Where the built pages are. Empty means out/ in export mode and .next/server/app in ssg-with-endpoints mode.
//endpoints: ssg-with-endpoints only: the folders where route handlers, server actions and request-time APIs may live. Anything outside them must prerender.
//sitemapExclude: Page paths that are deliberately not in the sitemap (thank-you pages, drafts). Glob patterns over the URL path.
//headersFile: The file your host reads response headers from: a _headers file, or an nginx config with add_header lines. Empty skips security-headers.mjs, loudly; then check the headers on the live URL.
//images: maxKB and maxWidthPx fail; modernFormatKB only warns (a PNG, JPEG or GIF above it should have an AVIF or WebP copy). unusedIgnore lists public/ paths whose URL is built at run time.
//bundle: First-load JavaScript and CSS per page, gzipped. Run `node scripts/check/bundle-budget.mjs --report` on your first build to see what the framework costs, then set these to what you ship plus headroom.
//a11y: a11y.mjs: the WCAG level (WCAG2A, WCAG2AA or WCAG2AAA) and page paths to leave out (glob patterns).
